game.tutorial.quickTap.step1: A hmasa berin thlalak pakhat i hmu a. Hriat reng tur — hei hi thlalak man tur chu a ni.

game.tutorial.pathMatch.step1: Numbered circle te chu screen ah hian a inzar pharh a.
game.tutorial.pathMatch.step3: Circle tin a inzawm vek hma loh chuan a hnuaia mi ang hian kal zel rawh — 3, 4, 5 —.
game.tutorial.pathMatch.step4: Level sang zawkah chuan timer a awm. I hun hmang la; dikna hi a pawimawh ber.
game.tutorial.countingBoxes.step1: Second tlemte chhung chu box stack a rawn lang a.
game.tutorial.countingBoxes.step2: Box tin chhiar la, a hnung lamah emaw, a chungah emaw dah khawm te pawh chhiar tel bawk ang che.
game.tutorial.countingBoxes.step3: Box te a bo chuan engzat nge i chhiar tih ziak rawh.
